# Replacements for SUI and ARB with a long history

Every coin listed on Binance perps before Dec 2021 (candle library), ADDED to the bot's current coins, same rules and risk. Pick window Jan 2022 → Dec 2023; check window Jan 2024 → Nov 11, 2026; and 2026 alone.
"Δ" = what adding the coin changes in the bot: total R, max drawdown, return ÷ drawdown. Tradable = MEXC futures volume ≥ $3M a day (live, Nov 12, 2026). Generated by replace-sui-arb.js.
